newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 14.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Finance Minister Jean Arthuis says Prime Minister Alain Juppe decides to postpone insurer GAN's subsidiary CIC bank privatisation, adds BNP offer was favoured by the privatisation commission.
-- Businesses prepare for changes in computer, accounting and tax areas expected to be go along with the shift to a single European currency from 1999.
-- Air Inter Europe pilots to strike on November 15 and 16 against merger with Air France.

-- Pilot's unions call for a November 27 and 28 strike, expected to affect all airlines, to protest the government's lack of action to prevent European competition distortions ahead of 1997 air deregulation.
-- Plastic Omnium to create joint-venture with U.S. Becker Group for plastic auto parts.
-- Credit Local de France to loan two billion francs to local authorities to help economic transition after defence sector restructuring.
